versions.changelog:
- Improved code and workflow consistency across scripts for grading, look selection, and LUT generation.
- Now removes obsolete `skill-card.md` in favor of inline protocol documentation.
- All scripts updated to ensure compatibility with legacy and new plan (`grade-plan.json`) formats.
- SKILL.md clarified and aligned with actual script behavior; examples and instructions polished for accuracy.
- Compatibility improved for migrating from `looks.json` to canonical `grade-plan.json` workflows.

Initial release of video-color-grade: a structured protocol for grading video as code.

- Enables scripted color correction, white-balance, exposure repair, log-to-Rec.709 conversion, named looks, skin-tone review, and portable .cube LUT delivery.
- Separates grading into a corrective base (for honest, neutral footage) plus a creative look layer.
- Provides a reproducible workflow: assess footage, generate labeled look frames, review skin tones, select a look (human or agent), bake LUT, and apply to the full video.
- Maintains protocol and review evidence for traceability, including rationale for look choice and reference files.
- Compatible with legacy and new schema for look definitions; supports seamless migration.
- Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python, numpy, and Pillow; keeps audio/video sync and original formatting.
